title: Wavelet Canonical Coherence for Nonstationary Signals
one_line: Wavelet扩展相干性方法，适用于非平稳多变量信号分析
method_framework: WaveCanCoh extends canonical coherence to nonstationary signals using multivariate locally stationary wavelet model, enabling time-frequency localized coherence estimation between clusters.
experiment_framework: MvLSW-based simulation and AR(2) mixture processes, plus LFP data from rat hippocampus during memory tasks.
takeaways: Wavelet-based approach captures transient, frequency-specific interactions
Method provides interpretable scale-specific time-varying interactions between clusters
weaknesses: Method relies on MvLSW assumptions which may not hold in all real-world scenarios
Computational complexity increases with number of channels and time points
